name: How long does a typical copper pipe repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical copper pipe repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a copper pipe repair can vary significantly depending on the extent of the damage and its accessibility. A simple patch or joint repair might take a few hours, while replacing a longer section of pipe in a difficult-to-reach area could take a full day or more. For example, a repair behind a wall or under a slab will involve additional time for access and restoration. When scheduling service, we can provide a more accurate time estimate after assessing the specific situation at your Las Vegas area property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies based on damage and accessibility, from a few hours for a simple patch to a full day for complex replacements.
